capabilities: Search books live by title, author, or ISBN across Google Books, Open Library, and Apple Books
Create book notes from customizable templates with variables for metadata, frontmatter, body, and file name
Link or download high-resolution cover images into the vault
Fetch or replace covers on existing book notes, including notes created by hand or by other plugins
Prevent duplicate notes by asking before creating an existing book's note
extras: Without a Google Books API key, search falls back to Open Library, which has a smaller catalog and less metadata; the key is stored locally in data.json and the plugin sends no telemetry.
intentEvidence: Book Search, the plugin that inspired this one. I used it for a while, but it is not actively maintained
motivation: The author used the Book Search plugin but found it unmaintained and wanted high-quality covers and a modern user experience for their book library.
problem: Keeping a book library in a vault means hand-writing notes with small or missing cover images, and the existing book search plugin is no longer maintained.
